description: Standard DocStrange extraction schema for JD PDFs. Extracts job details, required skills, and preferred qualifications as flat structured data for downstream ontology mapping.

job_details.description: Core job information extracted directly from the JD document.

job_title.description: The job title or role name

required_skills_and_competencies.description: List of all mandatory/required skills, competencies, and qualifications explicitly stated in the JD.

preferred_added_advantage.description: List of preferred/nice-to-have/added-advantage skills and qualifications.

responsibilities.description: Key responsibilities and duties listed in the JD.

requirements.description: Explicit requirements stated in the JD (education, certifications, etc.).
